metadata.name: Mackenzie River Expedition 2019: Fluorescence and Optical Measurements
metadata.description: This dataset contains measurements of fluorescence and optical properties collected during the Mackenzie River Expedition in 2019. It includes data on various fluorescence peaks (A-peak, C-peak, M-peak, T-peak) and fluorescence indices (FI, HI, BI) at different stations and depths. The data is geotagged with latitude and longitude coordinates and includes timestamps for each measurement.
